your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: p4 turned down both offers for St James. I'm keeping my cash ($1033). My targets are New York and Virginia, which are still unowned, plus Vermont to block light blue. I'll try p4 again once more of the board has been bought.
At $425 I'd drop to $318, which is too thin. I can go up to about $360. B&O is still unowned, so a third RR has upside, but I won't overpay.
Water Works means little to me. Trading it plus $300 keeps my cash at $443 and gets me 3 railroads. If p2 refuses, I can go up to $350 in straight cash at most.
Buying stops p2 (has Indiana) from getting 2/3 reds. Cash drops to $223, but nobody has houses yet so risk is low. Good trade chip. Illinois/B&O still unowned.
Cash is $223, so I'm not making trades I'd have to pay for. Nobody has a full set yet. Targets: New York/Illinois/B&O from the bank, St James from p4 later. Keep Kentucky to block p2 from 2/3 reds.

I can't afford $280 with $241, so I have to auction. p3 owns Ventnor and p4 owns Atlantic, so both will want Marvin to block the yellows or get to 2/3. I'll bid only cheaply, max about $120, and keep a cash buffer of around $120 for rent.

I have $241, which is too little to trade on. I'm keeping my blockers, Tennessee (orange) and Kentucky (red), plus my 3 railroads. New York is still unowned and is my key target for orange, along with St James from p4 later. p4 now has 2 yellows, so watch for Ventnor trades between p3 and p4.

Connecticut is the kingmaker piece. With it, p4 can swap light blue to p3 for Ventnor, which completes yellow for p4. I need real value back: St James gets me to 2/3 orange with New York still at the bank, and the cash rebuilds my buffer. I won't sell for straight cash.

If I sell Connecticut, p4 can complete yellow and p3 can complete light blue. That's two monopolies against me, so $250 isn't enough. I'll only sell for St James, which gets me to 2/3 orange with New York still at the bank. My fallback is to reject or ask for $450+ in cash.

This trade would give p2 2/3 orange, and New York is still at the bank, so orange is the most dangerous set for them to finish. In return I'd get Boardwalk, which is blocked because p4 holds Park Place, and red, which is blocked because p3 holds Illinois. Keep St James and Tennessee and aim for New York.

But p3's three light blue hotels carry steep rents (Oriental/Vermont $550, Connecticut $600), so bidding $200 would leave me dangerously thin against those. Still, denying p2 a complete railroad monopoly and securing that steady income stream might be worth the risk.
